About.title: About
About.subtitle: Vibecoder | Building AI-Powered Mobile Applications
About.quote: I conduct the AI symphony, it writes the code!
About.poetry: Code is poetry written for machines to execute and humans to understand.
About.intro: Moving beyond traditional software paradigms, I orchestrate AI models like Google Gemini and Claude via Antigravity IDE like a conductor, transforming ideas into polished, high-performance Android applications. The product vision, architectural direction, and user experience are crafted by me, while code synthesis and debugging are accelerated through AI collaboration.
About.pillar1Desc: Building robust, privacy-first mobile foundations with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and local-first Room databases.
About.pillar2Desc: Guiding Google Gemini and Claude models with precision prompts to architect clean systems, debug edge cases, and maintain code quality.
About.pillar3Desc: Directing end-to-end Google Play Store publication, Firebase cloud backends, and Google AdMob revenue integrations.
